data.content: In-Home Delivery, White Glove Assembly & Nationwide Shipping

data.title: In-Home Delivery with Assembly
data.content: Over 95% of deliveries are now made in-home with assembly included via well-vetted Independent Carriers. Includes delivery to your preferred room, light assembly, and packing material removal. Inspect thoroughly during assembly.

data.title: Freight / White Glove Shipping
data.content: White Glove services are automatically booked for freight shipments. Inspect during assembly — removing packaging greatly increases difficulty and cost of returns.

data.title: Threshold Delivery
data.content: Furniture arrives in plywood or cardboard crate on pallet, delivered to first dry area (garage/lobby). Have someone available to help move the piece. This method is used when in-home delivery is not feasible.

data.title: Communication Process
data.content: After your order, we send an Order Confirmation followed by a Shipping & Delivery Questionnaire — this is critical to complete. You'll then receive the carrier name and order/PRO number via email. Independent Carriers will contact you to schedule delivery.

data.title: Inspection Responsibilities
data.content: Inspect thoroughly BEFORE the carrier leaves. Damage must be noted on the Bill of Lading (BOL). Failure to note damage releases carriers from responsibility. You have the right to refuse a damaged delivery. For concealed damage, notify immediately via email with pictures.

data.title: Exceptional Shipping Services
data.content: Available with advance notice: NYC/Brooklyn delivery, island deliveries, spiral staircases, tight hallways, steep/narrow stairs. Rescheduling fees may apply for missed deliveries. Notify us via the Shipping & Delivery Questionnaire.

data.title: Storage Fees
data.content: 7 days free storage post-production. 7-14 days: 1% of order total per 7 days. 15+ days: 3% of order total per 30 days, up to 90 days maximum.
